text:
incidentbot: Automated page fired: PD alert PD-84721 -> eng-oncall (high) for host gpu-rack-47-n4: no-heartbeat detected, serial console not responding
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Incident PD-84721 triggered, escalated to on-call (maya)
maya: ack'd. i'm on it. grabbing serial console now.
kevin: i'm nearby, can help if you want me to take handoff after initial triage
sasha: FYI customer-impact check: metrics show ~2 active inference requests erroring for a single tenant in us-west-2, rate ~1req/s, spike started ~2m ago
maya: connecting to console -> `ssh console@gpu-rack-47-n4` timing out. trying IPMI web UI
incidentbot: Serial console attach attempt failed: no answer from BMC
leo: can we confirm kubelet status for node gpu-node-47? `kubectl get nodes gpu-node-47 -o wide`
maya: ran `kubectl get node gpu-node-47` -> STATUS Unknown, LastHeartbeatTime ~3m ago. kubelet not ready.
kevin: pulling kubelet logs from node via journalctl over ssh fails (ssh not reachable). Suspect host-level fault (kernel oops / watchdog)
sasha: telemetry shows spike in kernel messages around 2m ago: `kernel: BUG: unable to handle kernel NULL pointer dereference at 0000000000000000` and multiple Xid fault messages on GPU driver. attaching snippet:
```
[  141.394012] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, PID: 1234, GPU:0
[  141.394015] kernel: BUG: kernel NULL pointer deref in nvme_core
[  141.394020] systemd[1]: Starting Rotate log files.
```
maya: that looks like kernel oops + GPU driver fault. BMC unresponsive = host-level hang.
infra-oncall: recommend cordon + evict pods from that node via forced eviction to minimize customer impact. we have autoscheduler fallback set to non-preemptive; may need manual drain with `--force`
kevin: starting cordon: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-47` -> node cordoned
kevin: starting drain for inference pods: `kubectl drain gpu-node-47 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force` -> some pods HUNG in Terminating because of `container runtime: rpc error: code = Unknown`
sasha: those terminating pods are (inference-service-prod-*) for tenant-78. I see 4 replicas impacted -> degraded latency for their live requests. open a quick customer-impact note: tenant-78 experiencing 5xxs, to CS and PagerDuty customer notify if SLA threshold crossed
maya: attempted to trigger remote power-cycle via IPMI, BMC not accepting commands (connection reset). opening RMA ticket with colo. referencing serial unreachable ticket.
incidentbot: Update: Escalation to on-call-sr required (priority escalated after 4m unacked secondary). Notifying infra-oncall and ops-team.
leo: @infra-oncall if colo can't power-cycle soon, can we spin warm standby in another AZ for that tenant? We have reserved GPU capacity in us-west-2b but need routing change for in-flight connections
infra-oncall: we can push a quick routing override for tenant-78 -> will schedule cutover in 5m; note: traffic will see transient failures but should recover within 30-90s after DNS/cutover and client reconnects
sasha: creating a short lab incident note: "kernel oops + NV driver Xid79 -> host hang; BMC unreachable; draining failed for some containers; customer tenant-78 impacted; routing override initiated"
maya: handing off to kevin for follow-up / RMA coordination. i'm going to stay for final verification of cutover. 
kevin: ack handoff. I'll keep oncall channel and update RMA ticket. if colo can power-cycle, prefer that before RMA.
incidentbot: PagerDuty: PD-84721 acknowledged by maya, assigned to kevin after handoff
kevin: cutover kicked. monitoring logs: tenant-78 error rate dropping, pods rescheduled in us-west-2b standby. (confirm) 2m after cutover, 5xxs down to baseline. :thumbsup:
sasha: customer-impact: brief error window ~3m, estimated affected requests ~150, no SLA breach expected but CS will send a "we observed transient errors" note.
maya: leaving this channel but reachable. handing to kevin to close when host is RMA'd or recovered.
kevin: noted. tagging follow-up: post-incident actions -> (1) collect full kernel oops and driver logs from host once available, (2) run fleet-wide check for similar Xid79 regressions after last driver rollout, (3) add BMC heartbeat check alert to warn earlier
incidentbot: Incident PD-84721 status: Mitigated -> routing override applied, customer impact reduced. Incident remains open for RMA/forensics.
kevin: final note: created ticket RMA-2026 with colo ref 98122. will update when host reaches hands-on. closing slack thread for on-call coordination.
